title: Levels track scope of ownership, not years
takeaway: Each rung is a bigger problem with more ambiguity absorbed, and you do the next rung's work before you get its title.
sources: Levels are about scope of ownership.
Promotion to senior does not come from doing mid-level work faster or more elegantly.
You operate at the next level first. Then you get the title.

rungs.does: A task: you get told what to do
rungs.signal: Finishes things, asks for help in time

rungs.does: A feature: you fill in the details
rungs.signal: Ships a feature without being tracked

rungs.does: A project: you define the plan
rungs.signal: Vague problem in, a plan in a week

rungs.does: Multiple teams: you find the problem
rungs.signal: Impact across teams, not more code
